quick-slice.note: chain 1/3, restores 100 MP, 0 cd; chain link inferred, restore text from dump

savage-roar.note: engraves 1 Insignia 10s (confirmed); costs 120 MP; Inven: keep on its own manual key

savage-smash.note: engraves 1 Insignia 10s, 120 MP; spec 16 on Savage Roar pulls targets

ambush.note: base: +30% damage on a Back attack (positional, not modelled). Insignia only via specialty 1 (see specialization_effects)

heart-gore.note: auto proc: fires on landing a Critical Hit (crit trigger below), cd 5 s, restores 100 MP; Illusive Clone removing the cd and spec 16 reset-on-crit are NOT simulated (engine: proc owners do not feed crit specialties)

heart-gore-13350007.note: proc child of Heart Gore (same numbers)

savage-fang.note: engraves 5 Insignias 10s (confirmed); 50 stagger damage; opener skill before Triniel's Dagger

insignia-explosion.note: damage and Stun chance scale with stacks: 0:604/-, 1:677/10%, 2:749/20%, 3:822/30%, 4:894/40%, 5:967/50% (rank 1, Stun chance doubled on NPCs). Consumes stacks; spec 8 keeps 2 stacks. Whether stun applies at 0 stacks unknown

shadowstrike.note: moves behind target, Stun 3s guaranteed (confirmed); rank 8+ specs add Seal/Root 50%

whirlwind-slice.note: 40% Stun on Evasion (100% on NPC targets)

infiltrate.note: 50% Blind only after Dodge or while flying (100% on NPCs); Dark Strike chain with rank 12 spec

shadow-fall.note: requires a Stunned target (or 5% trigger vs Incapacitated Immunity); spec 8 engraves 3 Insignias

shadow-fall-13220037.note: proc child, 5% on attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity

storm-rampage.note: needs a Staggered target; spec 8 restores 120 MP; spec 16 -1s all cooldowns

storm-slice.note: chain skill from Defiance (spec 8); Stun 3s; cd 120s falling to 42s with rank

aerial-bind.note: 50% Airborne 3s; 100% vs 5 Insignia stacks or NPCs; whether stacks are consumed unknown

throw-shadowblade.note: Slow -40% 5s; Mobile skill (castable on the move)

smoke-bomb.note: Blind 5s; cd 30s in dump vs 60s on Metaroad

assault-ambush.note: 30% Blind 5s (100% NPC); Defense up to +20% by targets hit

triniels-dagger.note: +30% damage from behind; raises target skill cooldowns by 5%; Inven: use after Savage Fang

spiral-slice.note: removes 1 buff, +386 flat per buff removed (rank 1)

illusive-clone.note: removes Heart Gore cooldown + 20% of damage dealt as extra for 10s; burst window

swift-contract.note: +20% Combat Speed 10s; press before Illusive Clone (shorter animation)

surging-bloodlust.note: hidden skill, availability unknown; restores 300 MP

defiance.note: removes Stun/Knockdown/Airborne/Grab/Frost/Fear; ignores cooldown reduction; adds Storm Slice chain

shadow-walk.note: Stealth 20s, out of combat only (spec 15 allows in combat)

prepare-to-assassinate.note: hidden skill; Stealth 20s, out of combat only, cd 300s (no damage; out-of-combat utility, so it applies nothing in the rotation sim)

evasion-stance.note: guaranteed evasion briefly; restores 110 MP and Stamina once on Evasion

assassin_extensions._comment: NOT part of the sorcerer mechanics schema; structured extras for Assassin-only mechanics. Ignored by a loader that reads only the keys above.

manual_vs_macro.basis: Inven Sep 18/30 guides + aion2-assassin-guide.onrender.com (2026-10-03): game macro + normal attack held; buffs, movement, defense reactions, Savage Roar and conditional Insignia Explosion are pressed by hand

resources.MP: builders restore MP: Quick Slice 100, Breaking Slice 105, Swift Slice 120, Heart Gore 100, Storm Rampage +120 (spec 8); Savage Roar chain costs 120 each; Stamina used by Dodge/Evasion Stance (+110 MP once)
